title: Book Two · Chapter 145: A Page for a Stranger
story:
The last school month begins. Miss Wu invites pupils from another class to the reading activity. Each visitor brings one question card. The regular pupils have notices on their tables.

Ronan's notice is about a box of story sheets. The sheets can leave the room only in folders. Pupils must write a name on the list before they take one.

A younger girl sits opposite him. Her card says she needs a story for her little brother.

“Can I take one?” she asks.

“Yes. You need a folder and your name on this list.”

“His name?”

Ronan stops. He reads the notice again. It says: WRITE YOUR OWN NAME BEFORE YOU TAKE A SHEET. He points to that line.

“Your name. You are taking it.”

She asks where the folder comes from. Ronan finds a second line and shows her the low shelf. There are three empty folders there.

The girl takes a red one.

“Can my brother keep the sheet?”

“No. It comes back on Monday.”

“What if he wants to read it again?”

Ronan searches the last lines. They give no rule for a second week.

“I do not know from this notice,” he says. “You can ask the teacher in charge.”

The girl nods and writes her own name on the practice list. It is not a real loan today. She puts the folder back before she leaves.

Miss Wu asks her if the explanation was clear.

“Yes. He showed me my name part.”

Ronan waits for praise. Miss Wu writes a note, then moves to the next visitor.

After the practice, she gives him the sheet.

CLEAR ABOUT THE NAME. FINDS THE RETURN DAY. SAYS WHEN HE NEEDS MORE INFORMATION.

Ronan reads it twice. He likes every line.

Mei comes with her own note. Hers says she needs to leave more time for spoken questions.

“I read the right line,” she says. “Then I said it too fast.”

“I do that.”

“I know.”

She smiles. They both know Ronan sometimes speaks too fast in ordinary practice too. Ronan smiles back.

Leo has a good note too. Jun has a question about one of his answers and stays to ask Miss Wu.

Ronan looks at the three of them. Two future places. All four friends have done some useful work. Other pupils want to try too.

At home, he shows Mum his whole practice sheet. He tells her it was an ordinary practice with a visitor. It was not the final choice.

Mum reads the note and puts it back in his hand.

“That sounds like useful work.”

Ronan sits beside her and reads the story from the notice. This time the story is for him.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

folder＝文件夹；loan＝借出；spoken＝口头的；regular＝经常参加的。

## 理解问题

1. 谁需要在借阅名单写名字？
2. 老师肯定了Ronan哪些具体行为？

## 读句子

**The girl / takes / a red one.** 女孩／拿了／一个红色文件夹。
